claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if the collaboration produces no deployment/design win within two fiscal years, or if scale-up interconnect standardizes on copper/CPO paths that bypass OCS; upgrade when a hyperscaler or GPU vendor names OCS-based scale-up adoption.
claims.statement: Marvell and Lumentum jointly demonstrated OCS for next-generation AI scale-up infrastructure at OFC 2026 (Lumentum R300 OCS + Marvell Aquila/Ara 1.6T optical DSPs, live interoperation) — the first named supplier pair on the graph's scale-up optical interconnect layer. Architecturally this is the OCS route to scale-up; the CPO route (tech:scale_up_cpo) remains supplier-less in primary sources, so the two nodes represent competing approaches to the same layer function, not synonyms. Limits: joint vendor demo announcement, no hyperscaler customer or deployment named; NVIDIA-ecosystem scale-up remains copper-dominant today.

source_doc.title: Marvell and Lumentum to Demonstrate Optical Circuit Switching for Next-generation AI Scale-up Infrastructure (Marvell IR PR)

sources.quote: Optical circuit switching (OCS) for next-generation AI scale-up infrastructure, featuring live interoperation between Marvell optical connectivity solutions and Lumentum's OCS platform at OFC 2026.
Lumentum: Supplying the R300 optical circuit switch with scalable, low-loss switching architecture
Marvell: Providing optical connectivity solutions including Aquila 1.6T coherent-lite DSPs, Ara 1.6T PAM4 optical DSPs
AI scaling is pushing conventional packet-based networks beyond their practical limits.
